name: One-sided puller
what_it_does: Holds a plug with 2 prongs, or a USB-C tip, in its pocket; two fingers in its finger holes pull it straight out.
feel: A flat part about 6 mm thick: a shallow pocket and a notch at the plug end, two large round finger holes in the middle, a J-shaped cord hook slot at the cord end, four small zip-tie holes and two curved wing openings around the pocket; the pocket face has rounded edges.

name: Plate
what_it_does: Two identical plates close on a plug with 3 prongs from both sides; their toothed arms grip it and the zip ties hold the pair together.
feel: A flat plate about 4 mm thick: two round finger holes and a cord channel at the near end, two arms with rows of small teeth on their inner edges, small zip-tie holes along each arm and a long strap slot outside the teeth; the outer face has rounded edges, the inner face square edges.

name: Zip tie
what_it_does: Holds the tool on the plug: three hold the two-sided plates together, two hold the one-sided puller on.
feel: A thin plastic strip with a square head at one end; the tail goes through the head and holds.

name: Hook-and-loop strap
what_it_does: Holds the one-sided puller on its plug instead of the zip ties, or as well.
feel: A soft flat strap, hooks on one face and loops on the other.
